title: ctxpipe check trace
description: The gzip-compressed JSON that `pnpm checks:run --trace <dir>` writes to <dir>/trace.json.gz, and that CI uploads as the artifact trace-<commit>. For each traced check and test case, the source lines that the case executed. A reader rejects an unknown schemaVersion. A check that is not in the trace was not traced: that is not proof that it executes no code.

commit.description: The commit that ran the checks. Line numbers are lines of the files at this commit.

id.description: The check id from the manifest.

name.description: The full case name, as in the result records. `<collect>` is the code that ran outside a case: module evaluation, beforeAll and afterAll.

durationMs.description: The time of the case and its beforeEach and afterEach hooks.

lines.description: Repo-relative source path to the sorted, inclusive [first, last] line ranges that ran. A range can include lines with no code (blank lines, comments, types).
